members_and_selectors.independent: Four own native strict VAL-selected checkpoints per block, fixed registry member order0,1,2,3. Own selected stage can differ between members; no ensemble-selected epoch.
members_and_selectors.single_alias: Exact independent member 0 checkpoint/logits/hidden, no extra fit or extraction.

retained_logits.GNNM: Full FP32 [4,24492,5] promised in selected image selected_raw_logits and final SELECTED_LOGITS.pt raw_logits.
retained_logits.native: Full FP32 [1,24492,5] per independent fit; family torch.cat follows physical_fit_references.

hidden_retention: Implemented fit/snapshot path retains parameters/buffers/gradients/Adam/RNG/modes/stage and raw logits, not temporary penultimate activations; model forward stores them in local variables and returns logits only.

exact_hidden_interfaces.raw_feature_definition: The actual active BoundaryProjector argument, before multiplication by its private R[member]. Its effective affine-weight input is h*R[member], source line37; these are distinct interfaces. Minimal export chooses raw h.

population_and_order.population: All24492 native rows, preserving original feature-row/node index0..24491. No link candidate/negative-sampling population.
population_and_order.class_axis: Integer class0..4 from fixed output width/compact-label bounds; no class renaming/reordering.
population_and_order.member_order: GNNM forward0..3; independent exact registry physical_fit_references order.
population_and_order.role_order: Mask.nonzero supplies ascending native IDs; FIT/control retain original official TRAIN order after class-hash partition; roles pinned by consumer ordered_node_sha256.

frozen_roles.FIT: Per-class floor(4*n/5) of official TRAIN; counts 9795,9796,9795 across blocks. Only FIT labels enter model loss.
frozen_roles.TRAIN_control: Remaining official TRAIN; counts 2451,2450,2451. Decoded only for prefit stratified partition, excluded from model fit and VAL selection; control predictive evaluation requires separate authority after complete closure. Not a free fusion-training set.
frozen_roles.VAL: 6123 nodes each; already used for strict base checkpoint selection at each actual update. Not an untouched meta-selection or evaluation sample.
frozen_roles.TEST: Public role mask/features participate in transductive graph; no TEST label artifact/reader/score authority. Historical producer raw all-node label decode is disclosed in source metadata; no claim that labels were never decoded anywhere.
frozen_roles.head_fit_role: No new readout/fusion supervision role or arm allocated by current frozen study; this source report allocates none.

pooling_correction: Actual native four-member predictor is arithmetic mean softmax probabilities, with FP64 log-mixture for control NLL and FP32 probability pooling for selection/accuracy. The earlier generic mean-logit anchor would not preserve this predictor; source feasibility does not change pooling or prescribe a new arm.
full_graph_replay_needed: Selected-local uses all 10 complete GAT layers. Selected-global additionally has node-axis k*v and k_sum reductions over all 24492 nodes. Do not replace with control-only or subset-node forward.

analytical_export_cost.note: No native-single duplicate. Additional metadata/serialization headers, restored model/Adam state, temporary activations, CPU copies, export I/O and graph/head work are extra; no measured cheapness or sparse saving certified.
